Our curriculum will integrate theoretical knowledge with practical applications, enabling students to tackle real-world environmental issues.

Interdisciplinary Learning : Our department embraces an interdisciplinary approach, combining insights from Botany, Zoology, Food Science and Biotechnology. This holistic perspective will allow students to understand the interconnectedness of environmental systems and human impacts.
